# Shiny Garage

> Shiny Garage (شايني جراج) is a car protection and car care center in Mansoura, Egypt, with two branches: Toriel (paint protection film PPF, 3M heat insulation, Glass Guard) and Hay El Gamaa (car wash, car care and detailing, caliper color change, wheel painting and CNC repair, body and paint work). The full website is coming soon; customers book and ask about prices on WhatsApp.

مركز Shiny Garage لحماية وعناية السيارات في المنصورة، وليه فرعين: فرع توريل للحماية (أفلام حماية الطلاء PPF، عزل حراري 3M، Glass Guard)، وفرع حي الجامعة للعناية (غسيل، Car Care، تغيير لون الكاليبر، دهان وإصلاح الجنوط، سمكرة ودهان). الأسعار والحجز عن طريق الواتساب.

## Branches

- [Toriel branch – Protection](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJh912GQCd9xQRwB3FKimALsA): Saad Zaghloul St., Al-Haramain Tower, Toriel, Mansoura. Phone and WhatsApp: +20 100 008 5431. Services: PPF paint protection film, 3M heat insulation, Glass Guard.
- [Hay El Gamaa branch – Car care](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJGdU-d5Gd9xQRnKw5fYZSwGc): 45 El-Khalifa El-Maamoun St., off Ahmed Maher St., Hay El Gamaa, Mansoura. Phone and WhatsApp: +20 110 324 8800. Services: car wash, car care and detailing, caliper color change, wheel painting and CNC repair, body and paint work.
